meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任意文字内容变成生动的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把文章或笔记快速变成讲解视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn any text into an engaging explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn articles or notes into explainer videos quickly

howto.what: 把用户给的文本(文章、笔记、主题等)变成一个无脸解说视频项目:提取文本、选定视觉风格、写分镜和脚本、生成配音与音乐、逐帧制作画面,最后渲染成mp4。不依赖真实拍摄或网站截图。
howto.when: 当用户要求把文本做成解说视频时触发,典型场景如主题解说、概念拆解、操作指南等;若意图不明则交给/hyperframes。

say.text: 把这篇讲复利的文章做成无脸解说视频。
say.note: Claude会启动整个视频制作流程。

say.text: 用男性配音把这段笔记做成概念拆解视频。
say.note: 会先指定音色,再继续生成分镜和脚本。

say.text: 把这个主题做成列表式解说视频,时长1分钟。
say.note: 会按长度设定分镜并走完渲染。

howto.what_en: Turns user text into a faceless explainer video: creates a project, saves the text, picks a visual preset, writes storyboard/script, generates audio metadata, builds frames, renders mp4. No real capture or footage.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to turn text into an explainer video (topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, etc.). If unclear, it defers to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into a faceless explainer video.
say_en.note: Claude starts the full video production flow.

say_en.text: Turn this topic into a listicle explainer video, about 1 minute.
say_en.note: Durations shape the storyboard and final render.
